paragraphs.source_en:
Thou
hast made me known to friends whom I knew not. Thou hast given me seats in homes not my own. Thou hast brought the distant near and made a brother of the stranger.

units.source_en: Thou hast given me seats in homes not my own.
Thou hast brought the distant near and made a brother of the stranger.

ja.t: にしてくださいました。

paragraphs.source_en: I am uneasy at heart when I have to leave my accustomed shelter; I forget that there abides the old in the new, and that there also thou abidest.

units.source_en: I am uneasy at heart when I have to leave my accustomed shelter; I forget that there abides the old in the new, and that there also thou abidest.

ja.t: り、そこにもまたあなたがいらっしゃることを、

paragraphs.source_en: Through birth and death, in this world or in others, wherever thou leadest me it is thou, the same, the one companion of my endless life who

units.source_en: Through birth and death, in this world or in others, wherever thou leadest me it is thou, the same, the one companion of my endless life who

ja.t: かれるとしても、それはあなたです。

paragraphs.source_en: ever linkest my heart with bonds of joy to the unfamiliar.

units.source_en: ever linkest my heart with bonds of joy to the unfamiliar.

ja.t: びつけてくださるのです。

paragraphs.source_en: When one knows thee, then alien there is none, then no door is shut. Oh, grant me my prayer that I may never lose the bliss of the touch of the one in the play of the many.
